title: Workflow
description: Tasks to execute. DAG can be static (declared in YAML) or dynamic (generated by a planner agent at runtime).

agent_profile.description: Path or URL to an AgentProfile. Applied as defaults to all agents.

agents.description: Agent definitions. Each agent MUST have a name in workflow context.

tasks.description: Static task definitions. Dependencies via `needs` form the DAG. For dynamic DAGs, include only the planning task(s) and let the planner emit new tasks at runtime.

planning.description: Dynamic DAG generation. A planner agent produces the task graph at runtime instead of it being fully declared in YAML.

phases.description: Optional phase grouping. Phases execute in order; tasks within a phase execute per DAG.

mcp_servers.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server definitions available to agents in this workflow. Define connection config once here; agents declare which servers they can access via permissions.mcp.servers. Runtimes start declared servers before executing any tasks.

on_loop_iteration.description: Fires after each loop iteration completes. Receives loop.iteration, loop.max_iterations, and the iteration's outputs.

on_loop_max_iterations.description: Fires when a loop reaches max_iterations without exit_when triggering.

loop.description: Iterative execution config for the entire phase. The phase (all its tasks) repeats until exit_when is true or max_iterations is reached. Runtimes MUST reject phases with loop if any task within also has loop set.

Observability.description: Observability configuration. OAP defers to OpenTelemetry — runtimes SHOULD emit OTel-compatible spans for tasks, tool calls, and agent turns.

tracing.description: Tracing backend. Runtimes SHOULD support opentelemetry.

log_level.description: Minimum log level for structured log output.

log_format.description: Log output format. json emits NDJSON (one event per line). text emits human-readable output.

log_dir.description: Directory where per-run structured log files are written. Overrides the runtime's default log path. Supports ${ENV_VAR} interpolation. Example: ~/tmp/oa or /var/log/oap. When set, takes precedence over any user-level config. Each run writes one file named <workflow>-<timestamp>.log.

env.description: Environment variables available to all agents.

max_tokens.description: Max total tokens across all agents.

max_cost_usd.description: Max USD cost for entire workflow.

budget.description: Workflow-level budget. Agents' individual budgets are enforced within this ceiling.

concurrency.description: Named concurrency groups. Tasks with matching concurrency_group are throttled per these limits.

isolation.description: Default execution isolation for agents in this workflow.

resource_locks.description: Declares named resources available in this workflow. Tasks reference these via resource_locks. Runtimes use this for mutual exclusion scheduling.

model_tiers.description: Maps model tiers to concrete model identifiers. Agents use model_tier for portability; runtime resolves to actual models here.

max_parallel.description: Max tasks in this group that can run simultaneously.

queue.description: How waiting tasks are ordered. priority = uses task.priority field.

ModelTiers.description: Maps abstract tier names to concrete model identifiers. Runtimes MAY also accept these via env vars or CLI flags.

frontier.description: Best available model. Planning, architecture, complex reasoning. e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4', 'gpt-4o', 'gemini-2.5-pro'.

fast.description: Cheap and fast. Well-defined mechanical tasks. e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'gemini-2.0-flash'.

PlanningConfig.description: Dynamic DAG generation. The planner agent receives the workflow goal and constraints, then emits tasks at runtime.

agent.description: Agent name that generates the task DAG. MUST be defined in the agents array.

goal.description: What the workflow should accomplish. The planner uses this to generate tasks. Supports ${} interpolation.

max_tasks.description: Max tasks the planner can generate.

allowed_agents.description: Agent names the planner can assign tasks to. Omit for all agents.

require_approval.description: If true, generated plan requires human approval before execution.

replan_on_failure.description: If true, the planner is invoked again when a task fails, with failure context. It can adjust the remaining DAG.

level.description: shared = agents share process and filesystem. process = separate process per agent (default). container = OCI container per agent.

shared_filesystem.description: Whether agents share a common working directory. When false, each agent gets a private copy.

shared_network.description: Whether agents share a network namespace. When false, each agent has isolated networking (container mode only).
